limits: This is a new derived exploratory dataset, built from previously exposed registries and protocol. No new primary image, archaeological observation, custodian reply or holdout is asserted.
Pair counts describe finite logical alternatives after nuisance/equivalence collapse. They supply neither probabilities, confidence, regional rarity nor cross-project utility.

Guaranteed pair separation means disjoint compatible decisive-outcome sets conditional on every observation gate succeeding. A possible unresolved result prevents unconditional guaranteed identification.
Nuisance windows are unioned within assignment/reading families before identical signatures collapse. Model weights and duplicated parameter branches cannot increase influence.

Joint sets preserve the explicit nuisance-branch correlations; unrecorded within-branch correlations remain unknown. Different classes can have overlapping predictions, and an unknown expands to every decisive outcome. Partial empirical results require an explicit outcome-set preview rather than a forced category.

The seven acquisition tasks in the existing queue concern several independent claims. Their generic compatible/contradicted gate outcomes cannot be treated as mutually exclusive predictions of Koḥlit sites.

The finite Koḥlit roster is an implementation pilot, not a regional denominator. All equally available geographic alternatives, an independently reserved prediction and exposure audits remain necessary for identification.

Named dependency means a conditional plan with a precise source route; record survival, usability, access and timing are unverified. Unscoped dependencies are excluded from the named-dependency scenario.
No plans, requests, historical outcomes, rarity registrations, atlas data or deposit statuses are changed by this planner or an outcome preview.

The three letter observations share an image acquisition bundle and reader gates; observational component count is different from acquisition count. Existing frozen full-word success conditions still require every component to be decisive.
